landing.hero_title: Solar skills for the villages of Jamnagar
landing.hero_text: Free technician training, certificates employers can verify, and jobs close to home. Run from ten village hubs with Reliance Foundation.
landing.stat1_l: learners across 10 hubs, at least half of them women
landing.stat2_l: Suryamitra solar technician training at NSQF level 4
landing.stat3_l: earning within six months, ₹6,000–8,000 a month
landing.stat4_l: clean power a year from the hub rooftops, about 273 t of CO₂ avoided
landing.paths_title: One place from first lesson to first job
landing.paths_text: Most learners start with the flagship course and finish with a certificate and a job interview. Women's groups can go straight to enterprise support.
landing.p1_d: Short audio, video and hands-on lessons that run on any phone, even on a weak signal.
landing.p2_d: Assessments marked by external SCGJ assessors. Every certificate carries a QR code an employer can check.
landing.p3_d: Openings with Reliance vendors and EPC contractors around the Jamnagar perimeter.
landing.p4_d: Solar dryer playbooks, subsidy checklists and a profit calculator for women's self-help groups.
landing.shg_title: Solar dryers for women's self-help groups
landing.shg_text: A group that dries chillies and onions on a solar dehydrator can sell cleaner, longer-lasting produce at a better price. The programme brings ₹1.2 crore in margin money and helps groups claim the 35% PMFME subsidy.
landing.hubs_text: Each hub trains about 600 people from its cluster of villages.
